title: ApiReturnedRefcheckAction success clears refcheck_confirm for ANY row — a response for row B silently cancels a pending start/take-over confirm on row A
evidence:
+              // r3 (N2): only the MATCHING row's edit closes — another
+              // row's in-progress typed trio survives the refetch.
+              let edit_kept = case model.refcheck_edit {
+                Some(edit) if edit.call_id == call_id -> None
+                other -> other
+              }
+              let cleared =
+                Model(
+                  ..model,
+                  refcheck_edit: edit_kept,
+                  refcheck_confirm: None,
detail: The Ok arm scopes the edit cleanup to call_id but zeroes refcheck_confirm unconditionally. A pending confirm on row A is destroyed by any immediate action's response (e.g. skip on B) — the intended start/take-over never fires, silently.
recommended_fix: Mirror edit_kept: clear refcheck_confirm only when the pending confirm's call_id equals the responding call_id; leave other confirms intact.

title: Single refcheck_edit slot: opening a second row's edit-trio silently discards the first row's typed trio
evidence:
+        RefcheckSubstitute -> #(
+          Model(
+            ..menu_closed,
+            refcheck_edit: Some(prefill_refcheck_edit(
+              model,
+              call_id,
+              RefcheckEditSubstitute,
+            )),
+          ),
+          effect.none(),
+        )
+        RefcheckCorrect -> #(
+          Model(
+            ..menu_closed,
+            refcheck_edit: Some(prefill_refcheck_edit(
+              model,
+              call_id,
+              RefcheckEditCorrect,
+            )),
+          ),
+          effect.none(),
+        )
detail: With an edit open on row A (typed landlord PII), choosing Correct/Substitute on row B overwrites the single refcheck_edit slot with no warning; A's typed values vanish, contradicting the r3 N2 preserve-typed-values intent.
recommended_fix: Before replacing a dirty edit, either keep the prior row's edit (per-row state) or require an explicit cancel; at minimum confirm before discarding typed values.

title: Inline "Cancel" string in new view_edit_trio violates the spec's "No inline strings" rule
evidence:
+      html.button(
+        [
+          attribute("data-testid", "refcheck-edit-cancel-" <> slot),
+          attribute("type", "button"),
+          event.on_click(msg.UserCancelledRefcheckEdit(call.reference_call_id)),
+          class("px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm text-slate hover:bg-slate-100"),
+        ],
+        [html.text("Cancel")],
+      ),
detail: Spec OWNS #12 mandates all new strings live in copy.gleam ("No inline strings"), and every other RC4.3 string here is a const/function; the new cancel button is the one inline exception.
recommended_fix: Add a copy.refcheck_edit_cancel const ("Cancel") and reference it instead of the literal.

title: Spec menu mapping promises "Objected → Substitute referee" but overflow_actions returns [] for Objected rows — no ⋯ menu renders
evidence:
+    - overflow `⋯` menu (per-row open state): Queued → Start this check now / Skip this
+      reference; Skipped → Start this check (re-enable); ContactInitiated → Take over
+      manually; Unreachable → Take over manually / Substitute referee; Objected → Substitute
+      referee. AwaitingCorrection → no menu, the row detail IS the correction UI (§8.3).

+    Unreachable ->
+      list.append(
+        case call.hooks.can_take_over {
+          True -> [RefcheckTakeOver]
+          False -> []
+        },
+        case call.hooks.can_substitute_referee {
+          True -> [RefcheckSubstitute]
+          False -> []
+        },
+      )
+    _ -> []
detail: The spec's menu table lists an Objected → Substitute referee entry, but the implemented case sends Objected to the catch-all, so the row shows no overflow menu; substitution is only reachable via the row-body button.
recommended_fix: Either add the Objected menu entry (per spec) or amend the spec/epic menu mapping to match the body-only affordance.

title: view_edit_trio's effective-trio fallback branch is unreachable at both call sites — and would prefill the terminal referee's trio for substitute if ever reached
evidence:
+  let #(name, email, phone, saving, error) = case edit {
+    Some(e) if e.call_id == call.reference_call_id && e.kind == kind -> #(
+      e.name,
+      e.email,
+      e.phone,
+      e.saving,
+      e.error,
+    )
+    _ -> #(
+      effective_name_value(call),
+      effective_email_value(call),
+      effective_phone_value(call),
+      False,
+      None,
+    )
+  }
detail: Both callers gate on the identical call_id+kind predicate before invoking view_edit_trio, so the fallback never executes; if a future call site reaches it for substitute it would prefill the terminal referee's own trio — the exact r2 W5 empty-prefill violation.
recommended_fix: Remove the unreachable fallback or make callers pass explicit prefill values; never default the substitute surface to the terminal referee's effective trio.
